title: Preservation of free-variable agreement under clause processing
statement: Fix a list of literals with position indices and a decision-tree path, and let $\rho_0$ and $\sigma$ be two restrictions on $n$ variables that agree on which variables are free: for every variable $v$, $\rho_0(v)$ is free if and only if $\sigma(v)$ is free. Let $\rho_0'$ and $\sigma'$ be the updated restrictions produced by processing the clause's literals against the path starting from $\rho_0$ and $\sigma$. Then $\rho_0'$ and $\sigma'$ again agree on their free variables: for every $v$, $\rho_0'(v)$ is free if and only if $\sigma'(v)$ is free.
